value.rationale: Two natural, distinct network performance criteria—number of occupied sites by deadline and reliability of reaching at least one designated remote refuge—produce a nontrivial Pareto choice for the minimal six-site two-arm network with a third integer topology. The exact all-deadline phase diagram shows a robust, strictly intermediate unequal design, and both critical reward weights are explicit for any positive dimensionless deadline. This is useful as a small structural benchmark and does not require an empirical downstream theorem.
